text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet wasn't feeling well, so I 
brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Trainer... It appears I 
require a brief respite to suppress this 
curse...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, will the god of slumber grant me 
peace, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Voice
text_block_list.text:
—Can you hear me? Can you hear my 
voice...? Gimlet-san... no, God of 
Destruction...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: This voice is...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road?
text_block_list.text:
"You have a mission. To destroy the fences 
that divide the world, all of them... Now 
is the time to unleash your inner power!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho... An inner power, is it? You say a 
mystic chaos slumbers within me...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuhahaha! What a turn of events! Very 
well, I shall unleash our wings...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road?
text_block_list.text: Yes...! The power hidden within you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road?
text_block_list.text:
It's super... super, like, dark powers...! 
Destroying lots of things!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahahahaaa!! So this is what 
awakening feels like!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I have realized it... I understand now...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"This other world exists only to be 
destroyed! So that we may proceed toward 
true rebirth!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh-kuh! Bwahahahaha! Break it! 
Kick it down! Go thoroughly mad!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I am the calamity itself!!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Is that...!? Could it be the 
legendary sky-striding Umamusume...?!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
How divine... Ah, destruction is the only 
noble truth... This fleeting brilliance is 
proof that we are alive...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Exactly. "Live in this moment." It 
seems you lot have finally enlightened 
yourselves as well...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road?
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent...! As expected... you truly 
are an incredible God of Destruction.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road?
text_block_list.text:
There are still many in this world who 
await your destruction.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road?
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, more destruction...! 
Um... more, much more! Let us cause lots 
of destruction!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I understand. Shall we embark on this 
endless journey of destruction...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: There are no longer any fences around us!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "Bwaaa-hahahaha! Haaaa-hahahahahahahaaa—!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Ha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry. Did I wake you up?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were in the nurse's office, so 
I came by to visit... but you're looking 
pretty good!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...? What about... your journey... of 
destruction...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"No... merely a trick played by the god of 
dreams, perhaps? Heh heh heh... Not a bad 
illusion at all...!"

Tanino Gimlet had a sweet dream and seems 
to have regained her top condition!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kuhahahaha...! —Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What the?! All of a sudden, a wall of 
fences...! Kh! Get out of my way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road?
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! The fence is moving...!? It's pulling 
us apart! No way! Gimlet-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Dammit! I'll tear this fence down myself!
(Bang! Bang bang! Bang bang bang!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Why!? Why won't it break!? There is 
nothing that I cannot destroy—!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Ha!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A nightmare... Good grief, what a tragic 
end that isn't one bit funny...

Tanino Gimlet woke up grinding her teeth. 
Her condition remained poor...
